jump: Slider capped at 1.2 (step 0.05). Root cause of 'above 1.2 jumps lower': the launch frame(s) still report IsGrounded()==true, so the scaled gravity is integrated into the very start of the ascent and cancels the impulse. Above ~1.2 the cancellation outweighs the gain, producing a lower jump. A gravity-multiplier cannot deliver clean high jumps here.
recommended: For real height use Bay gravity: apex = H * |g_rise| / |g_custom|, so lowering the Bay value raises the apex linearly (4.9 -> 2x, 3.27 -> 3x, 2.45 -> 4x) and stays smooth.
